source_note: Original retained kernel journal subset; not a full boot journal
analysis_method: Parse literal recorded lines, count reset starts/successes and first fault within 10 wall-clock seconds after each observed GPU reset(N) succeeded. Executed read-only through connected GitHub source on 2026-11-14; no GPU operations.
limitations: 88 reported soft resets are not 88 proven functioning GPU recoveries
two full-reset success messages in retained file do not establish number of all resets between counters 2 and 62
success followed by fault does not prove hardware never passed basic ring tests
post-reset VM fault does not distinguish bad kernel mapping, stale userspace graphics context or hardware TLB/cache/firmware
no physical GPU or kernel executed
